The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of remote sensing data and activity information derived from time series of satellite data can be used to produce national estimates of forest AGC loss with a high degree of certainty.
the use of remote sensing to monitor forest carbon stocks and loss is feasible in countries where NFI data is either non-existent or outdated, such as in the DRC.
it is possible to estimate national-scale forest AGC loss in a developing country without the use of in situ measurements.
